name: Yardeni Research
description: Independent financial research firm (Dr. Ed Yardeni) publishing daily Morning Briefings and a library of 7,600+ real-time charts on markets, valuation, earnings and the economy. A handful of sample charts are free; the full daily briefing library and chart archive are subscriber-only. Used here as a design/framing reference for how a professional research shop labels and annotates long-run valuation and market-structure charts.

notes: A small number of sample charts and search are free without an account.
Full access (Daily Morning Briefings, the 7,600+ real-time chart library, QuickTakes, the AI research assistant) requires a paid subscription; a four-week free trial is offered with no credit card.
Older PDF chart books are also reachable at archive.yardeni.com (e.g. individual 'Stock Market Briefing' PDFs), which appears to be a legacy/archival mirror rather than the current product.
